{{Quote|Diplomacy failed the Republic long ago.|Halle Burtoni|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
'''Halle Burtoni''' was an elderly [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] who represented her [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and by extension she represented her [[Kamino system/Legends|star system]] and the unnamed [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of stars in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The original suppliers of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that composed the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the Kaminoan [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]' [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Tipoca City/Legends|facilities]] were essential to the Republic's war effort against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Their contribution facilitated Kamino's entry into the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Republic, leading to Burtoni's appointment to the ranks of the Senate. As a politician, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Burtoni was a strong advocate for the increased production of clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], mainly to further the interests of her [[Planet/Legends|world]] and to better enable the Republic to defeat the Separatists through force. Her political positions were supported by many [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] allies in the Senate, but were also opposed by the senators who advocated for diplomacy. Burtoni's chief political enemies included fellow senators such as [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==Biography==
===Senator of Kamino===
{{Quote|Senator Burtoni, the Kaminoans might have bartered their creation of the clones into a seat in the Galactic Senate, but this does not give you free reign.|Onaconda Farr|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
[[File:PhaseIIArmor-SM.png|thumb|left|250px|Burtoni presents her people's new and improved armor designs for the clone troopers to a group of fellow politicians.]]

Halle Burtoni's political career began as a result of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic-wide]] conflict that started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] after diplomacy failed to resolve the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Armed rebellion broke out, and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] found its sovereignty threatened by the so-called [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At the same time, however, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], located within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], unveiled its decade-long secret project&mdash;the mass production of an army composed entirely of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> As a result of the war, the production of clones became the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]' most valuable commodity, and thus Kamino was admitted into the Republic as a member world with representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Rewarded with a seat in the legislative branch of the Republic government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Kamino selected Burtoni to serve as a senator.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

As a politician, Burtoni cultivated allies and enemies within the Senate. On the one hand, her support for the war was opposed by other senators such as [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], both whom wanted to end an illegal rebellion through negotiation with traitors. However, she also found strong supporters in [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]], the senator of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], and [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] as well.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> A strong lobbyist for the maintained&mdash;or increased&mdash;production of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Senator Burtoni and her allies achieved a political victory with the passage of a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|Senate Bill]] that authorized the creation of five million additional clone troopers.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> Later in the war, Burtoni presented a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic display]] of the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]], an improved version of the clones' [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|original armor]], to a group of politicians, including Amedda and Deechi.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

===Partisan politics in the Senate===
{{Quote|Senator Burtoni, this is a private conversation.''"<br />"''Private conversation or Separatist conspiracy?|Padmé Amidala and Halle Burtoni|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
Although pacifism and diplomacy failed to prevent the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Senator Padmé Amidala continued to advocate for negotiation with the Separatists. With the support of like-minded senators such as Onaconda Farr, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], Amidala introduced a [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|legislative bill]] to further her personal ideals. If passed, the bill would have ceased the production of clone troopers, leaving the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] deprived of additional soldiers. Aside from the fact that the bill threatened the economic interests of Kamino, Burtoni resented Amidala and her allies for proposing legislature that would have placed the Republic in a strategically vulnerable position. Hence, she suspected treachery in Amidala's party, and even accused them of conspiring against the Republic as Separatist sympathizers.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

Shortly after Burtoni's confrontation with Amidala, Farr suddenly collapsed and [[Death/Legends|died]]. The suspicious circumstances behind the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] senator's death prompted an [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] investigation by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], headed by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]]. An autopsy of Farr's body produced evidence that he had been murdered by [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. Amidala immediately suspected Burtoni and Deechi of foul play, despite the fact that she lacked any evidence other than motive to support her theory.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

===Murders in the Senate===
{{Quote|Every time Ono opened up his befuddled mouth, it gave us another quote to use in our fundraising. Why would we kill our best source of income?|Halle Burtoni|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
[[File:BurtoniDeechi-SenateMurders.png|thumb|right|250px|Burtoni and Deechi, fellow senators and political allies]]

Amidala soon confronted them both in Deechi's office, but Burtoni dismissed the senator's accusations as illogical. She asserted that Farr's ineffective ability as a political speaker was useful to her fundraising campaigns. Deechi also denied the allegation of murder and claimed that he respected his late rival; Burtoni gladly revealed how she never respected the Rodian. However, Deechi revealed that Farr had a secret meeting with an unidentified individual at the [[Docks under the derrick major/Legends|Coruscant docks]]. When Amidala and Organa attempted to investigate the area, they were nearly killed by an unknown assailant. Both Amidala and Organa suspected Deechi of plotting their deaths. They moved to confront him, only to discover that the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] senator had been assassinated. With Deechi dead, suspicion fell increasingly on Burtoni.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

===The true murderer is revealed===
{{Quote|Ono was a harmless bug. I wouldn't bother killing him, and Deechi was my ally.|Halle Burtoni, to Tan Divo|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
[[File:HalleBurtoniArrested-SM.png|thumb|left|250px|Senator Burtoni is wrongfully accused of conspiracy, assault and murder by Lieutenant Divo.]]

When [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]], a colleague of the late Onaconda Farr, accused Burtoni of assault and attempted murder, Lieutenant Divo issued a warrant for the arrest of the Kaminoan senator. Burtoni was soon apprehended and brought to the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]] at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] by the CSF where she was interrogated by Divo in front of a group of politicians, including Amidala and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Burtoni proclaimed her innocence and denied Purs' accusation of assault, as well as any involvement in the assassination of Farrs, whom Burtoni regarded as too insignificant to kill. As for Deechi, Burtoni claimed that she had no motive to murder her own political ally.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

However, Divo was certain that Burtoni was the murderer. With only suspicion and circumstantial evidence at best, the CSF officer believed that Burtoni was responsible for the death of Farr because of the fact that she left Amidala's office just before Farr died. He believed that Burtoni was the one who secretly met with Farr, and that she killed Deechi to hide the truth. A forensic analysis of Farr's corpse also yielded results that confirmed the poison in his system to be of Kaminoan design. Furthermore, it was designed to be lethal only to those who possessed Rodian [[DNA/Legends|DNA]]. Divo concluded that Burtoni was guilty because she was a Kaminoan, and thus she had the motive, means and opportunity to kill Farr.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

Amidala, however, realized that the lieutenant's assumption was flawed because of the fact that the poison was in the other senators' drinks, including Lolo Purs. As a Rodian, Purs should have been killed as well, but only if she drank the poison. Just as the truth dawned on Amidala, the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Rodian pulled out a concealed [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and took her former friend as a hostage. With Purs revealed as the true killer of Farrs and Deechi, Amidala demanded an explanation. Purs confessed how she secretly loathed Farrs and regarded him as a traitor to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. She also believed that he was too weak in his opposition to the Clone Wars. At that moment, two CSF [[Police droid/Legends|police droids]] appeared behind Purs and startled her. Amidala swiftly took advantage of the distraction and disarmed the Rodian with a single punch to the face. The revelation of Lolo Purs' crimes absolved Halle Burtoni of Divo's accusations.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

===Burtoni's victory in the Senate===
{{Quote|With the final votes tallied, let it be known that the motion to stop the creation of more clone troops has failed, and the continued manufacturing of clone troopers shall proceed as scheduled.|Chancellor Palpatine, announcing the defeat of Amidala's bill|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
[[File:Reduced_Military_Spending_Bill.png|thumb|right|250px|The Senate majority rejects the bill proposed by Amidala's faction.]]

After the incident at the Republic Executive Building, the members of the Galactic Senate voted on Amidala's bill. The majority voted to oppose the bill in favor of the continued production of clone troopers, and thus Burtoni and her allies won a major political victory against Amidala and her supporters. Once the session concluded, Chancellor Palpatine consoled the defeated Amidala and claimed to oppose Burtoni as well. However, he also asserted that the majority had decided and the democratic system had to be upheld, to which Amidala agreed. On the other hand, Palpatine also confessed that he understood Burtoni's point of view. He defended his reasoning by implying that it would be hypocrisy for the Senate to increase its own defenses while depriving the Republic of the soldiers it desperately needed.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|For the record, I had no respect for Onaconda whatsoever.|Halle Burtoni, voicing her personal dislike of Onaconda Farr|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
[[File:HalleBurtoni-TCWCE.png|thumb|left|180px|Senator Halle Burtoni of Kamino]]

Halle Burtoni was strong-minded<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and resolute behind her opinions;<ref name="Senate Murders" /> her political savvy and powerful connections made her a well-respected individual amongst her colleagues in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and her own [[Kaminoan/Legends|people]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> As a politician, her primary concern was the promotion of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] interests, such as the production of clone troopers. She was also loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and regarded the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] as traitors. Burtoni's animosity toward the Republic's enemies, as well as her rivalry with those who opposed her positions, caused her to suspect treachery within the ranks of the Senate.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> A strong proponent for the continued manufacturing of clones,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Burtoni's politics made her enemies with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who hoped to end the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by demilitarizing the Republic.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

Senator Burtoni was characteristically aggressive and intrusive. Some of her colleagues suspected the Kaminoan delegate of engaging in illegal and unethical activities in order to further her own political career. She was well aware of the clone troopers' importance to her [[Planet/Legends|world]], especially since they earned Kamino a place in the Republic and a seat on the Senate.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Hence, any legislation that aimed to decrease&mdash;or even terminate&mdash;Kamino's most valuable commodity was opposed by Burtoni.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halle Burtoni was voiced by [[Jameelah McMillan]] and was first identified in the episode [[Senate Murders]].<ref name="Senate Murders" />
